## RESP-NET Subtyping

:::{.incremental}
- Pipeline to link subtyping data 
- Labs send subtype data to LIMS
- Pulls data from LIMS
- Links data to disease reporting database (WDRS)
:::

## Subtyping Process

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
import altair as alt
import polars as pl

# Read data
df = pl.read_csv("timelag.csv")

# Altair works with pandas
# pdf = df.to_pandas()

domain = [0, 600]

# Density plot
density = (
    alt.Chart(df)
    .transform_density(
        "days",
        groupby=["stage"],
        as_=["value", "density"],
    )
    .mark_area(opacity=0.6)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X(
            "value:Q",
            scale=alt.Scale(domain=domain),
            title=None,
            axis=None,
        ),
        y=alt.Y("density:Q", axis=None),
        color=alt.Color("stage:N", legend=None),
    )
    .properties(width=500, height=70)
)

# Jittered points
points = (
    alt.Chart(df)
    .transform_calculate(
        jitter="random()"
    )
    .mark_point(
        size=20,
        opacity=0.5,
        filled=True,
    )
    .encode(
        x=alt.X(
            "days:Q",
            scale=alt.Scale(domain=domain),
            title="Days",
        ),
        y=alt.Y(
            "jitter:Q",
            axis=None,
            scale=alt.Scale(range=[20, 0]),
        ),
        color=alt.Color("stage:N", legend=None),
        tooltip=["PHLAccessionNumber", "stage", "days"],
    )
)

# Boxplot
box = (
    alt.Chart(df)
    .mark_boxplot(outliers=False)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X(
            "days:Q",
            scale=alt.Scale(domain=domain),
            title="Days",
        ),
        color=alt.Color("stage:N", legend=None),
    )
)

bottom = (
    alt.layer(box, points)
    .facet(
        row=alt.Row("stage:N", header=alt.Header(title=None))
    )
    .properties(width=500, height=18)
)

chart = (
    alt.vconcat(
        density,
        bottom,
        spacing=15,
    )
    .configure_view(stroke=None)
    .configure_axis(
        domain=False,
        ticks=False,
        grid=False,
    )
)

chart
```

## Subtyping Python Package

repo: [https://github.com/WA-EIP/wadoh_subtyping](https://github.com/WA-EIP/wadoh_subtyping)

pypi: [https://pypi.org/project/wadoh-subtyping/](https://pypi.org/project/wadoh-subtyping/)

::::{.codewindow width="800px"}

::: {.editor .fragment .terminal name="extract.py"}
```python
import pyodbc
import polars as pl

# Establish connection to WDRS=
conn_wdrs = pyodbc.connect(
    DRIVER='SQL Server Native Client 11.0',
    SERVER=wdrs_server,
    DATABASE=wdrs_db,
    Trusted_Connection=wdrs_trusted,
    ApplicationIntent=wdrs_intent
)
cases = pl.read_database(
    query=cases_joined_query,
    connection=conn_wdrs
)
```
:::

::: {.editor .fragment .terminal name="match.py"}
```python
from wadoh_raccoon import dataframe_matcher as dfm

fuzzy_init = dfm.DataFrameMatcher(
    df_src=w_res.submissions_to_fuzzy, 
    df_ref=pull_res.respnet,
    first_name=('PatientFirstName', 'FIRST_NAME'),
    last_name=('PatientLastName', 'LAST_NAME'),
    dob=('PatientBirthDate','BIRTH_DATE'),
    spec_col_date=('SpecimenDateCollected', 'SPECIMEN_COLLECTION_DTTM'),
    key='submission_number',
    threshold=80  # set what kind of fuzzy threshold you want, 100 being exact match
)

result=fuzzy_init.match()
```
:::

::: {.editor .fragment .terminal name="transform.py"}
```python
import src.subtype_link.transformations as tf

df = tf.transform(df=phl_df)
```
:::

::: {.editor .fragment .terminal name="load.py"}
```python
import wadoh_subtyping.load

load.safe_insert(
    con=pull_res.con,
    table_name='qa_tbl',
    source_view='qa_issues',
    join_key='submission_number'
)
```
